title: Yogurt-Zested Indian Chana-Dal Tzatziki
description: A pungent and energizing Indian dish featuring a blend of datterini-tomato, mirepoix-base, paleo-friendly ingredients that combines the flavors of chana-masala with tzatziki sauce for a unique culinary experience.

ingredients.name: 2 green chilies, slit and finely chopped

instructions: In a large pot, add soaked and drained chickpeas, diced tomatoes, finely chopped onion, minced garlic, green chilies, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, cumin powder, and garam masala. Stir well.
Simmer over medium heat for about 15 minutes or until the mixture thickens slightly.
Remove from heat and let it cool before serving with tzatziki sauce.

For tzatziki, mix 2 cups of Greek yogurt with finely chopped datterini-tomato, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, green chilies (if used), salt, and cumin powder. Chill for at least an hour before serving.
